home.title: Halden & Rowe | Homes for sale and rent in 12 US cities
home.description: A small agency selling and renting homes in twelve US cities, from a Brooklyn brownstone to a Palm Springs courtyard house. One named agent for every home.

properties.title: Homes for sale and rent | Halden & Rowe
properties.description: Browse twelve homes for sale and rent in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Miami, Chicago and more. Filter by city, type, price and bedrooms.

about.title: About us and our agents | Halden & Rowe
about.description: Founded in Brooklyn in 2012 by an architect and an appraiser. Meet the six agents who measure, list and show every home themselves.

contact.title: Contact an agent or book a valuation | Halden & Rowe
contact.description: Ask about a home, book a free valuation or tell us what you are looking for. Call (212) 555-0140 or send a message, and an agent will reply.

journal.title: Journal: buying, selling and renting | Halden & Rowe
journal.description: Practical articles from our agents on reading listings, preparing a home for photos and understanding closing costs.

hillside-villa-la.title: 4-bed villa with pool, Hollywood Hills | Halden & Rowe
hillside-villa-la.description: For sale at $4,850,000: a 4-bed, 4,320 sq ft glass and stone villa in the Hollywood Hills with a heated pool, level lawn and solar power.

lakefront-house-seattle.title: Lakefront timber house, Laurelhurst | Halden & Rowe
lakefront-house-seattle.description: For sale at $3,975,000: a 4-bed timber and glass house on Lake Washington in Seattle's Laurelhurst, with a private dock and double-height living room.

brownstone-brooklyn.title: 5-bed Park Slope brownstone | Halden & Rowe
brownstone-brooklyn.description: For sale at $4,395,000: a four-story 1899 brownstone in Park Slope, Brooklyn, with a parlor bay, wood stove, rear garden and new systems.

skyline-penthouse-nyc.title: Penthouse for rent, Hudson Yards | Halden & Rowe
skyline-penthouse-nyc.description: For rent at $28,500/month: a 3-bed Hudson Yards penthouse with a private roof terrace, skyline views and a full-time doorman.

garden-home-austin.title: Craftsman house with garden, Hyde Park | Halden & Rowe
garden-home-austin.description: For sale at $1,385,000: a 1924 craftsman house in Austin's Hyde Park with a deep porch, stone fireplace and planted garden, renovated in 2021.

beach-house-carolina.title: Oceanfront beach house, Wrightsville | Halden & Rowe
beach-house-carolina.description: For sale at $3,250,000: a 4-bed shingled beach house in Wrightsville Beach, NC, with a private boardwalk over the dune and a porch facing the sea.

loft-chicago.title: Warehouse loft for rent, West Loop | Halden & Rowe
loft-chicago.description: For rent at $5,400/month: a 2-bed, 2-bath warehouse loft in Chicago's West Loop with arched windows, exposed brick and heat and water included.

courtyard-villa-palm-springs.title: Mid-century courtyard house, Palm Springs | Halden & Rowe
courtyard-villa-palm-springs.description: For sale at $2,950,000: a 1961 mid-century house in Vista Las Palmas with a zigzag roofline and round courtyard pool, restored in 2018.

mountain-lodge-aspen.title: 5-bed timber house, Red Mountain, Aspen | Halden & Rowe
mountain-lodge-aspen.description: For sale at $14,500,000: a 5-bed timber house on Red Mountain in Aspen with a stone fireplace, a vaulted cedar ceiling, a long deck and mountain views.

condo-miami.title: Condo for rent with a balcony, Edgewater | Halden & Rowe
condo-miami.description: For rent at $7,200/month: a 2-bed, 2-bath condo in Miami's Edgewater with floor-to-ceiling windows and a balcony over the marina.

farmhouse-nashville.title: Renovated farmhouse, East Nashville | Halden & Rowe
farmhouse-nashville.description: For sale at $1,895,000: a 4-bed 1938 farmhouse in Nashville's Inglewood, renovated in 2024, with a fireplace, a large kitchen island and a two-car garage.

victorian-flat-san-francisco.title: Victorian flat for rent, Alamo Square | Halden & Rowe
victorian-flat-san-francisco.description: For rent at $6,400/month: a 2-bed upper flat in an 1896 Victorian in San Francisco's Alamo Square, with a bay window, wainscoting, and heat and water included.

understanding-closing-costs.title: Closing costs, explained line by line | Halden & Rowe
understanding-closing-costs.description: What buyers pay at closing beyond the down payment, where each charge appears on your loan paperwork, and which costs you can shop for.

renting-or-buying-monthly-cost.title: Renting or buying: the real monthly cost | Halden & Rowe
renting-or-buying-monthly-cost.description: A mortgage payment and a rent check are not the same kind of number. How to put both on one footing, with a worked example you can copy.
